summary: A follow-up list where each row has a title and an inline subtle Badge pill with a status dot: Overdue (danger), Due today (warning), Done (success) and a neutral Draft without a dot.
use: Status pills next to a title in lists and queues. The pill sits in text flow; it is not anchored to a corner like a count badge.
spec: Unstyled list with a grid and `gap: var(--ca-space-2)`; each `li` is a wrapping flex row
Title `span` in `--ca-text-primary`, followed by `<Badge tone="danger" subtle dot size="md">Overdue</Badge>`
`tone="warning"` Due today and `tone="success"` Done, both `subtle dot size="md"`
`tone="neutral" subtle size="md"` Draft with no dot
